# Blacktop Brawl

> Free, independent browser motorcycle combat racing game by Sanket Shinde. Road Rash-inspired; not affiliated with Electronic Arts.

## Official links
- [Game information, controls, and FAQ](https://sanketshinde3001.github.io/blacktop-brawl/): Official website.
- [Play Blacktop Brawl](https://blacktop-brawl.vercel.app/): The playable JavaScript game. No download or account required.
- [Source code](https://github.com/sanketshinde3001/blacktop-brawl): TypeScript, Vite, Canvas 2D, and Web Audio.

## Game facts
- Five career levels across Sierra Nevada, Pacific Coast, Redwood Forest, Palm Desert, and Grass Valley.
- 12 bikes and engine, tyre, brake, armour, and nitro upgrades.
- Career, quick race, endless, daily challenge, and local two-player split screen.
- Keyboard, gamepad, and landscape touch controls.
- Finish fourth or better to qualify. Races have 14 rivals plus the player.
- Progress is stored locally in the browser; no account-based cloud save.
- Multiplayer is local on one device, not online matchmaking.

## Controls
Arrow keys: ride. A/D: hit. S: kick. Space: nitro. Hold Q: look behind. E: camera. Esc: pause.
